from reconcile import *
def main():
    result={};errors=[]
    def check(ok,what):
        if not ok:errors.append(what)
    manifest=json.loads(confined('staged-manifest-v2.json'))
    selected=[p for p in manifest if re.fullmatch(re.escape(AUDIT)+r'stage-b/application(?:-overlay)?/G\d{3}\.json',p)]
    data=batch(sorted(selected));count=0;eff={}
    for p,raw in data.items():
        group=json.loads(raw);eff[group['id']]=group
        for row in group['rows']:
            if not row.get('normal_called'):continue
            stack=group['stack'][row['index']-1]
            check(all(row[k]==v for k,v in stack.items()),'stack-to-row '+p+':'+str(row['index']))
            check(row['normal']['argv']==['patch','-d',row['candidate_root'],'-p1'] and row['backend']=='patch','backend argv '+p)
            check(row['normal']['start']<=row['normal']['end'],'call timestamps '+p)
            count+=1
    result['stack_row_and_normal_argv_bindings']=count
    for name,v in j('stage-d/check-summary.json')['checks'].items():
        check(sha(b(v['receipt']))==v['sha256'],'D summary receipt '+name)
    rows=j('stage-b/table-input.json');groups=set()
    for row in rows:
        path=row['path'];groups.add('/'.join(path.split('/')[:4]) if '/devices/' in path else path.split('/patches/')[0])
    check(len(groups)==31,'31 independently derived prefixes');result['prefixes']=sorted(groups)
    opened=j('stage-b/open-inputs.json');result['open_owner_native_keys']=dict(collections.Counter(x['owner'].split(':',1)[0] for x in opened))
    result['open_inputs_sha256']=sha(b('stage-b/open-inputs.json'))
    result['original_weak_empty_prefix_count']=len(j('stage-d/empty-prefix-observation.json')['records'])
    result['producer_execution_census']=j('stage-b/execution-census.json')
    # Bind raw tracker creation/parent readback command exits and output identities.
    tracker=[]
    for stem in ['audit-rest','parent-attach','parent-readback']:
        record=j('stage-d/'+stem+'.json')
        for stream in ['stdout','stderr']:check(sha(b('stage-d/'+stem+'.'+stream))==record[stream+'_sha256'],'tracker '+stem+' '+stream)
        tracker.append({'name':stem,'exit':record['exit'],'stdout_sha256':record['stdout_sha256'],'stderr_sha256':record['stderr_sha256']})
